task.description: Produce the fix design for ISS-0137 / GH #439 as a Type E prose design at src/design/test-wiring-iss0137.md. The diagnosis (docs/issue-reports/ISS-0137-diagnosis.yaml) already classifies all 55 files into 7 clusters C1-C7 with per-file dispositions -- your job is to turn that into an unambiguous implementation design BACKEND-DEV can execute without further decisions. Resolve every open decision the diagnosis defers, specifically: (1) the C3/C4 overlap -- src/oidc/claim_mapping.zig would become BOTH a named module root (C4) AND reachable from src/oidc_test_root.zig (C3), which risks a Zig 'file exists in two modules' error; decide whether the C3 oidc shim refAllDecls the NAMED modules or relative paths, and state the rule generally so the same conflict cannot recur for the other overlapping files; (2) exact content and location of each of the 7 new *_test_root.zig shim files; (3) exact build.zig edits per cluster (module declarations, addTest roots, Run steps, test_step.dependOn wiring, and which narrow test-<name> steps to expose); (4) the two required source fixes -- iss206_token_multiset_test.zig's bpm.engine_transition symbol and exp601_tier_quota_test.zig's ../../src relative-import escape (specify the fix approach, not the code); (5) whether tools/lint_test_wiring.py needs the exclusion mechanism -- the diagnosis assigns zero files to DOCUMENTED_EXCLUSION but flags wasm_executor_test.zig as a possible conversion if Wasmtime linking is required; design the exclusion mechanism as a YAML file requiring reason+issue_ref (never an inline source pragma, which would let a future agent silence the gate by editing what it measures). Design must preserve the Green-Main Gate: no file needing BPM_TEST_DB_URL or Keycloak may land on `zig build test`. Note that src/wasm liveness is now tracked separately as ISS-0147 / GH #463 -- design C5 so it does not depend on that decision.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/test-wiring-iss0137.md exists as prose design with no implementation code
C3/C4 module-ownership conflict resolved with a stated general rule
Every new shim file named with its exact purpose and refAllDecls target
Every build.zig change specified per cluster with its build step attachment
Unit-vs-integration split preserved: zero live-service files on `zig build test`
Linter exclusion mechanism designed (YAML, reason+issue_ref, no inline pragma)
C7 closing condition specified: promote test-wiring-check into test_step only after linter exits 0

result.summary: Type E prose design at src/design/test-wiring-iss0137.md. Resolved the C3/C4 module-ownership conflict with a general Single-Owner Module Rule (a file that is a named-module root must be reached by NAME everywhere, incl. shims; verified all 12 src/oidc files use only named imports, so the rule is free there). Inverted the cluster order (C4a modules must precede C3 shims). Specified all 6 src/ shims + 3 tests/unit aggregators, 15 new b.createModule decls, 9 addTest triples with narrow test-<name> steps, and the integration_imports extension. Source fixes decided: iss206 fixes the test symbol to bpm.transition (no alias); exp601 gets two new src/bpm.zig re-exports (quota_policy, quota_enforcement) since bpm.zig exported neither. Exclusion mechanism designed as tools/test_wiring_exclusions.yaml (path/reason/issue_ref/added_at, hard-fail on invalid entry, always printed) but deferred: both DOCUMENTED_EXCLUSION candidates resolved to WIRE IT. Promoted linter improvement L-2 (named-module edge resolution) from optional to REQUIRED -- the Single-Owner Module Rule makes 14 files invisible to the current regex BFS, so C7 cannot reach exit 0 without it. Green-Main Gate split verified by spot-check: 33 files/141 blocks on test, 21/184 on test-integration, zero live-service files on test. Recorded 7 corrections to the diagnosis.
